title: Bible Story: The three Hebrew men
status: draft: written 19 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 3 Christian Religious Education; not yet checked by a CRE teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child narrates the three Hebrew men in the furnace (Daniel 3) and names lessons: worship only God, God protects, be brave.

floor.prerequisite: Knows Daniel in the lions' den.
floor.question: Who shut the lions' mouths?

steps: Say why they refused to bow.
contexts: friends pressuring a child to do wrong
standing up for what is right

board.say: How many men did the king see in the fire?

board.do: Wait for the child to say four.

misconceptions.ask: Where were Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego thrown?
misconceptions.repair: Put two pictures side by side: Daniel and lions, three men and fire.

misconceptions.ask: What did the three men do when told to bow to the golden image?
misconceptions.repair: Read Daniel 3:16-18. They chose God over the king.

misconceptions.ask: Who was the fourth man in the fire?
misconceptions.repair: Read Daniel 3:25, 28: God sent his angel.

misconceptions.ask: How were the three men when they came out?
misconceptions.repair: Read Daniel 3:27 and ask what was strange.

checks.question: Why were the three men thrown into the furnace?
checks.answer: They refused to bow to the golden image

checks.question: Name a lesson from the story.
